User.title: User
User.description: Learner account profile, XP, and daily streak progress.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user (Firebase Auth UID).

lastActiveDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD date stamp of last activity.

dailyGoal.description: Target number of flashcards per day.

SRSItem.title: SRSItem
SRSItem.description: Spaced repetition state for a specific vocabulary item.

nextReview.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for next scheduled review.

historyCount.description: Total times this item has been reviewed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this record was updated.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User preferences for display, theme, audio, and furigana.

showFurigana.description: Whether to render furigana annotations above Kanji.

showRomaji.description: Whether to show Latin phonetic reading.

/users/{userId}.description: Root user profile document storing XP, streak, and daily goals.

/users/{userId}/srs/{vocabId}.description: Individual SRS progress record for each Japanese vocabulary item.

/users/{userId}/settings/display.description: User preferences for Japanese learning interface and audio.
